prose.text: A static medium close-up frames the driver through the windscreen: the neon yellow tracksuit and red heart-shaped sunglasses catch the dusk light. The camera sits at eye level, three metres back on the street, locked off. The massive concrete tower rises centered behind the car, its stepped balconies and recessed windows filling the background. No camera movement; the only motion is the faint idle vibration of the car.

The camera tracks parallel to the street at a constant three-metre offset, holding a wide shot on the white sports car as it pulls away from the tower and accelerates down the empty boulevard. The four circular LED headlamps bloom in the gathering dark. The brutalist tower slides leftward across the background, its vertical staining catching the last light. The move is slow and unhurried, matching the car's smooth departure.
Cut to black. The screen remains completely dark for an extended beat, silencing the city.

A static medium shot on the tower roof: the driver stands centered, neon yellow tracksuit vivid against grey concrete, red heart-shaped sunglasses reflecting the city lights far below. The camera sits five metres back on the roof surface, slightly elevated, looking toward the front edge. The vast brutalist structure drops away behind him. No movement; the wind barely stirs the yellow hat.

The camera tracks sideways at a steady five-metre distance, maintaining a medium wide shot as the driver walks the length of the roof toward the front parapet. He arrives at the edge and looks straight down over the sheer concrete face to the deserted street 150 metres below. The move is slow, deliberate, unhurried; the city's faint glow rises to meet him.

prose.text: The camera tracks low and left-to-right alongside the wet pit lane as the Bored Ape strides toward the jacket-mannequin, rain dripping from his neon tracksuit and neon reflections shimmering on the asphalt.

The camera pushes in slowly to focus on the ape as he slips the deep-red velvet jacket over his shoulders, adjusting the silver filigree collar while rain streaks the visor of his red heart-shaped sunglasses.

The camera continues tracking the ape’s steps to the camouflaged supercar, then arcs slightly around the vehicle as he pulls the door handle and slides into the driver’s seat, interior lights flashing.

The camera pulls back gently as the car accelerates past the barrier, its bright yellow wheels spraying rain, while the pink-haired rival watches from the concrete barrier, headlights cutting through the mist.
